ALAS ROBAN THE SERIES
Official Collaboration between ANTV and CIPTARIA STUDIO

Dare to cross the deadly path of Alas Roban?

The legendary terror of Alas Roban is now even more chilling! Through the official collaboration between ANTV and Ciptaria Studio, a new horror experience inspired by Alas Roban The Series is now available!

Experience the terror of the night bus journey from Pekalongan to Semarang. Explore a dark route filled with mysteries, supernatural events, and terrifying figures lurking along the way.

WHAT AWAITS YOU?

- A horror adventure along the legendary Alas Roban trail.
- Exclusive map for Alas Roban The Series.
- Terror of supernatural beings and hidden mysteries.
- Horror experience with friends.

Dare to take the last bus to Alas Roban?
